title: Adaptive and oblivious statistical adversaries are equivalent
abstract: arXiv:2410.13548v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We resolve a fundamental question about the ability to perform a statistical task, such as learning, when an adversary corrupts the sample. Such adversaries are specified by the types of corruption they can make and their level of knowledge about the sample. The latter distinguishes between sample-adaptive adversaries which know the contents of the sample when choosing the corruption, and sample-oblivious adversaries, which do not. We prove that for all types of corruptions, sample-adaptive and sample-oblivious adversaries are \emph{equivalent} up to polynomial factors in the sample size. This resolves the main open question introduced by [BLMT22] and further explored in [CHL+23].   Specifically, consider any algorithm $A$ that solves a statistical task even when a sample-oblivious adversary corrupts its input. We show that there is an algorithm $A'$ that solves the same task when the corresponding sample-adaptive adversary corrupts

translated_title: 自适应与遗忘型统计对手的等价性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2410.13548v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们解决了一个关于在对手破坏样本时执行统计任务（如学习）能力的基本问题。此类对手由其可实施的破坏类型及其对样本的了解程度来刻画。后者区分了两类对手：样本自适应对手（在选择破坏方式时知晓样本内容）和样本遗忘对手（不知晓样本内容）。我们证明，对于所有类型的破坏，样本自适应对手与样本遗忘对手在样本规模的多项式因子意义下是等价的。这解决了 [BLMT22] 提出并在 [CHL+23] 中进一步探讨的主要开放问题。具体而言，考虑任意算法 $A$，即使样本遗忘对手破坏其输入，该算法仍能完成统计任务。我们证明存在算法 $A'$，当相应的样本自适应对手破坏输入时，该算法同样能完成该任务。
tldr: 本文证明了对所有类型的破坏，样本自适应对手与样本遗忘对手在样本规模的多项式因子意义下等价，从而解决了 [BLMT22] 提出的主要开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that sample-adaptive and sample-oblivious statistical adversaries are equivalent up to polynomial factors in the sample size for all corruption types, resolving the main open question posed by [BLMT22].
